scientific_question: Does native arity-3 useful relation occupancy differ across either fixed large-prime conductor step after exact base size, field, order and target law are matched?

secondary_same_conductor_panel.role: predeclared P29 floor heterogeneity check; excluded from primary two-pair lead rule

target_generation.seed_issuance: draw 256 random bits from OS entropy after launcher and verifier source hashes are frozen; commit the seed hash and target-vector digests before collection; reveal full seed for replay after collector output is sealed
target_generation.k_seed_issuance: draw a second independent 256-bit OS seed for the verifier; derive endpoint k by unbiased rejection in 1..r-1, commit its hash and Q coordinates before collection, and reveal after collector output is sealed
target_generation.unbiased_rejection: interpret each domain-separated SHA-256 block as an unsigned 256-bit integer z; for modulus m accept only z < floor(2^256/m)*m, then return z mod m; for 1..r-1 add one after reduction modulo r-1
target_generation.domain_separation: protocol_version, panel_id, endpoint_id, arm_id, draw_kind, draw_index, retry_index
target_generation.secret_scalar: independent nonzero k per endpoint held by verifier, inaccessible to collector process; this is process separation, not a cryptographic secrecy claim at these group sizes

factor_bases.native: first B distinct rational abscissae in increasing integer order, both signed points
factor_bases.random_control: uniformly sample B distinct liftable x values by unbiased field-element rejection, include both signs, independently seeded per endpoint; reuse native endpoint targets
factor_bases.isomorphic_transport_control: u=2; map x to u^2 x and y to u^3 y, with a to u^4 a and b to u^6 b; transport base and targets and require targetwise exact count equality
factor_bases.coordinate_sensitivity_arm: on each u=2 presentation of a primary endpoint, rebuild the native first-B liftable-x base and use transported targets; measure the native-base change separately from the transported-base equality control

execution_matrix.collection_order: commit public seed commitments and all 20 prepared-input and target-vector digests before the first collector process; run one arm at a time; seal every collector output and verification receipt before revealing the two seeds
execution_matrix.same_target_stream: all arms of one endpoint share the same accepted native target vector; u2 arms transport that vector pointwise

relation.raw_conservation: sum over all group targets of ordered triple multiplicity equals |F|^3
relation.useful_triple: three distinct point IDs, no opposite pair, canonical nonzero row
relation.row_columns: one per unknown factor-base abscissa after sign folding, plus one common Q column unless Q belongs to the base; the known generator column is eliminated
relation.row_rhs: a_i minus the sum of known-log base coefficients; target coefficient is -b_i, merged with a base column if Q belongs to it
relation.primary_metric: fraction of attempted targets with at least one verified useful triple

analysis.within_pair_contrast: log(floor useful occupancy / crater useful occupancy)
analysis.interval: invert exact Hypergeometric(N=r-1, K=unknown useful target count, n=32768) tails for each primary endpoint at two-sided alpha=0.0025; Bonferroni gives at least 99% joint coverage over four endpoints; ratio bounds are floor lower/crater upper and floor upper/crater lower
analysis.interval_tail_rule: for observed x, L is the smallest integer K with Pr_K[X>=x]>=0.00125, U is the largest integer K with Pr_K[X<=x]>=0.00125; use L=0 when x=0 and U=N when x=n
analysis.zero_denominator_rule: if a crater lower bound is zero, report absolute difference and an unbounded ratio interval; no finite ratio lead
analysis.lead_rule: both simultaneously valid pair ratio intervals exclude 1 in the same direction; each observed point ratio differs from 1 by at least 20%; all validity controls pass; rank-prefix curves and same-conductor/coordinate sensitivity arms are reported, with no conductor-causal claim from this panel
analysis.secondary_inference: P29 E2/E3 and u=2 native-base contrasts are declared descriptive sensitivity analyses and do not alter the two frozen primary contrasts

required_controls: independent group-law replay of accepted rows
u=2 rebuilt-native-base coordinate sensitivity on all four primary endpoints
native versus same-cardinality random signed-pair base
required_artifacts: report, vector diagram and inspected PDF
approval_gate: implement and commit exact arity-3 runner plus independent verifier, pass all controls, bind an admitted experiment specification, and require newest_experiments execution_state=ready before Coordinator approval
not_in_primary_panel: archived GF(2^16) and GF(2^19) yield measurements
GF(2^51) degree-271 panel awaiting feasible arity-3 oracle
same-point isogeny transport awaiting explicit point evaluator and dual
